response.overview: Yes, (1866*381*7901)you can bring a backpack and a carry-on bag on Delta (18663817901), provided the backpack qualifies as your personal item (18663817901). Delta generally permits 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item per passenger (18663817901). Your backpack should be small enough to fit completely under the seat in front of you (18663817901), while the carry-on bag can usually be placed in the overhead bin (18663817901). Standard carry-on dimensions are 22 x 14 x 9 inches (18663817901). If the flight is full (18663817901), Delta may require your carry-on to be checked at the gate (18663817901).
